The Article 13 bank/cooperative rate schedule is modeled as separate group-specific scalar parameters (beginning with `bank_contribution_group_1_upper_profit`) rather than a versioned parameter table indexed by the statutory grouping/threshold dimensions. This is prohibited semantic/structural compression for a source-stated schedule.

The Article 9 late-payment penalty calculation is uncapped. The statutory monthly penalty is subject to its maximum legal limit; multiplying indefinitely by `months_or_fractions_late` can produce a penalty exceeding the legally permitted amount.
